title: memcpy with caller-supplied length may overflow fixed-size destination buffer
detail: src/aurora/aurora-storage/src/chunk.cpp:L27 calls std::memcpy(c.id, id.c_str(), id.size()) where id.size() is the caller-supplied string length and c.id is a fixed-size array; no bounds check is performed before the copy, so a string longer than the array overflows the destination.

title: std::rand() used for placement group selection in placement_group()
detail: src/aurora/aurora-storage/src/chunk.cpp:L36 uses std::rand()%groups to select a placement group; std::rand() is not cryptographically secure and its output is predictable, which may allow an attacker to influence placement outcomes if the seed is recoverable.
